def_en: 1) to call, call out, recite, read, cry out, proclaim
1a1) to call, cry, utter a loud sound
1a2) to call unto, cry (for help), call (with name of God)
1a4) to read aloud, read (to oneself), read
1a5) to summon, invite, call for, call and commission, appoint, call and endow
1a6) to call, name, give name to, call by
1b2) to be called, be proclaimed, be read aloud, be summoned, be named
1c) (Pual) to be called, be named, be called out, be chosen
kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.
expl: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
etim: a primitive root (rather identical with through the idea of accosting a person met);
